name: GPU Marching Cubes (Compute Shader)
definition: A GPU-based implementation of the Marching Cubes algorithm for Unity, generating a density field on the CPU and extracting the isosurface using a compute shader.
summary: GPU Marching Cubes is a compute shader that extracts isosurfaces from volumetric data by parallelizing voxel processing and using append buffers to handle variable triangle counts without pre-allocation.
